newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Key Stantronic shareholders sell other firm.
newsitem.headline: Key Stantronic shareholders sell other firm.

text.p: South Africa's Gary and Alan Abrahamson, the principal shareholders in newly-listed Stantronic Group Ltd, have sold their 51 percent stake in Standard Plumbing for an undisclosed sum.
The sale was made to Rolf Frolich Construction (Pty) Ltd, a member of South Africa's Odyssey Group, a statement from the firms said on Monday.

It said that Standard Plumbing had not been part of Stantronic and that the deal, effective from July 1, reflects Gary Abrahamson's determination to focus on Stantronic's core electrical contracting and commercial refrigeration operations.
